verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Trigger.dev tasks being started programmatically from your own backend code via the SDK (`task.trigger()`, `triggerAndWait()`) and on cron schedules. Nothing documents native triggers from events in connected apps, such as new records, messages, emails, or form submissions. One community remark compares it to IFTTT/Zapier-style linking 'in code', but that describes perceived positioning, not a documented connected-app event trigger, so any such wiring appears to require the user's own code.
